summary.text: Kris Schultz is a Democratic state representative from Merrimack 29 and a member of the Concord City Council, and she is seeking re-election to the New Hampshire House in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as community organizer.

paragraphs.text: Kris Schultz lives in Concord, New Hampshire, and earned a B.A. from American University in 1991.

Her career experience includes working as New Hampshire lead organizer with One Fair Wage, as director of communications and outreach with the New Hampshire Bible Society and the New Hampshire Council of Churches, and as a political campaign consultant.
Schultz's tenure in the New Hampshire House began in 2017, according to Ballotpedia.
She also represents Ward 9 on the Concord City Council, where she took office on January 1, 2024, and her term there ends in 2030.
In the 2023-2024 session she served on the Labor, Industrial and Rehabilitative Services Committee as clerk.
